Gumroad, on the other hand, provides a more flexible platform for creators to sell digital products, but it's still beholden to the whims of payment processors like Stripe and PayPal. In contrast, NOWPayments offers a truly sovereign approach to payment processing, allowing creators to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies and process transactions without the need for intermediaries.
